children: Mediclinic Middle East, one of the leading private healthcare providers in the UAE with the majority of its operations in Dubai and Abu Dhabi, is set to invest AED420 million ($114 million) in the expansion of Mediclinic Parkview Hospital in Dubai.

Following the expansion, Mediclinic will be able to boost the hospital's capacity mainly for specialised services, including oncology, paediatrics, musculoskeletal care, sports medicine and physiotherapy, while adding day-surgery theatres and day-care facilities.
The project will also include a dedicated paediatric urgent care unit and expanded oncology facilities, as well as infrastructure to support future developments in cancer treatment.

Mediclinic said the expansion would also strengthen the hospital's digital and operational capabilities through automation and smart technologies aimed at improving the integration and efficiency of clinical services.

Dr. Alawi AlSheikh Ali, Director General of the Dubai Health Authority, said investment in the development of specialised hospitals and health centres reflects the evolution of the emirate's healthcare sector towards more specialised and integrated services, and strengthens the system's ability to deliver advanced care close to the community, in line with the highest standards of quality and safety.

"The private healthcare sector is a strategic partner in developing Dubai's healthcare system. We are keen to ensure that high-value investments add new capabilities and broaden the scope of specialised services, in keeping with the aspirations of the community, while enhancing Dubai's competitiveness and its standing as a leading destination for healthcare and medical tourism," he stated.

On the expansion, Mediclinic Middle East CEO Hein van Eck said: "This investment reflects our confidence in the direction of Dubai's healthcare sector and the remarkable progress it is making. It also reflects our commitment to continuing to develop our services in step with the emirate's rapid growth and the needs of its residents."

"The expansion of Mediclinic Parkview Hospital will increase our capacity in a number of specialties that are seeing growing demand, and create a more integrated care experience for patients and their families," he stated.
"Through this project, we aim to raise the hospital's capability, enabling it to respond to both current and future needs," he added.-

title: ZAWYA: Mediclinic unveils $114mln Dubai hospital expansion plans
